candidate: M145 repaired defensive ACG conditional-Haar-frame transport
objective: Reduce the adjusted score of the exact Formal-L1 row-blocked estimator while preserving its radial, antipodal, pruning, fold3, tangent, and all-output semantics.
bias_class: The ACG change of measure and centered complete-frame correction are conditionally unbiased in real arithmetic. Float32 uses a log-domain full-mixture weight with a proved normal-range envelope. The remaining approximation class is exactly Formal L1's frozen pruning/fold/tangent class.

proposal.spectral_construction: full symmetric float32 scatter plus full eigh; selected covariance is a spectral matrix function
proposal.boundary_tie_rule: if eig[r]-eig[r+1] <= 128*eps32*max(1,abs(boundary eigenvalues)), return the uniform proposal

integration.random_unit: one complete 256-line Haar frame with both antipodes
integration.setup: build four pilot and 122 main QR frames from disjoint child seeds and store one in-place row-frame bank
integration.predict: run the four pilot frames first to freeze Formal-L1 active/fold regimes and proposal; tilt 122 stored main frames in place; use complete-frame coefficients in every sample mean and first-layer moment residual; restore frames with the same reflectors
integration.antipodal_order: line coefficients duplicated in the exact [positive block, negative block] order
integration.forbidden: pointwise ACG weights on dependent frame or MUB/Kerdock nodes

native_trace.kind: target-shaped sidecar structural trace only; no MSE or truth

promotion_gate.primary: paired per-network official adjusted score candidate/formal-L1 ratio
promotion_gate.sealed_m71_proxy: candidate adjusted-score bootstrap upper90 must be below 2.05e-7
promotion_gate.raw_mse_ratio: secondary diagnostic only; it cannot promote the candidate
promotion_gate.resource: zero failures; every candidate C below 258.4B safety line and 272B cliff; setup<4s; predict<20s; peak<512MiB
promotion_gate.same_backend: Formal L1 and M145 must use the same generated networks, seed root, row-blocked backend, runner, radialization, and scoring function

firewall: No target efficacy run until second hostile audit. No contest weights, truths, public/private rows, scorer outputs, leaderboard data, submission, or champion replacement.
preexecution_kills: generic input-permutation covariance or boundary-tie fallback fails
any float32 full-mixture weight is zero, nonfinite, or above 1.25
Formal-L1 source hashes or crosswalk hooks do not match
native sidecar loses frame restoration, setup, wall, peak-memory, or safety gates
any cell other than P1024/r16/M122 is executed
